description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Philippines Philippines nationwide presidential-proclamation calendar result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when local-government special holidays, employer schedules and 2027 Eid dates pending a separate proclamation are not inferred.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2027 authority events.
Example user requests: Philippines: EDSA remains a special working day. | Philippines: Eid'l Adha is a declared holiday.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-02-25"} | {"date":"2026-05-27"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/philippines-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/philippines-public-working-day.md
name: check_ph_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Regular, special non-working, additional special non-working and special working classifications are preserved; Eid dates are included only after a dated proclamation.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: No additional substitute-day or local-celebration rule is inferred beyond the published proclamation dates.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Philippines Working Day
